scope: Separately approved compatibility repairs. Original observations remain immutable. These expectations were observed from the private prototype and independently checked against explicit conservation, refusal, receipt and named-difference rules.

decisions: Purchases refuse nonfinite currency, nonfinite investment, nonfinite or negative costs, and NaN requests before any spending.
Ordinary positive infinity requests retain the original finite clamping. Negative infinity requests retain zero clamping. Memory and relic services retain their own finite-request constraints.
Investment reads and writes use own properties. Legacy investment migration also uses own destination balances and safe writes.
Memory completion resolves the authored reward definition and reads its own receipt, independent of the offer ID.

Outright purchase success requires the requested grant to have completed. An investment return value of zero alone cannot distinguish a free grant from refusal. This applies to memory and relic services as well as ordinary purchases.
Original source fixtures and the exact parity prototype remain unchanged. Each resulting difference requires a named independent assertion.
